## Smartsheet - Senior Software Engineer II – Solution Lifecycle

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/smartsheet/jobs/8239800)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building scalable backend services and reliable core infrastructure for Smartsheet’s work-management platform. Tackling distributed systems, databases, automation, and AI-enabled engineering.
Senior Software Engineer building Smartsheet’s scalable backend and core infrastructure platform
- Salary: $175,000 - $245,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, Kotlin, MySQL, Python, Terraform, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Design and build scalable back-end services for Smartsheet's next-generation applications
- Solve complex distributed systems challenges with product management and key stakeholders
- Build, maintain, and scale Smartsheet's core infrastructure for reliability, stability, and performance
- Manage and upgrade large-scale database infrastructure and complex replication topologies
- Automate core operations using AWS, Golang, MySQL, Terraform, Temporal, and GitLab-CI
- Collaborate through mob programming, collective code ownership, code reviews, and architectural discussions
- Use Test-Driven Development to build resilient foundational systems
- Participate in team book clubs and psychologically safe retrospectives
- 8+ years of experience and proficiency in at least one modern programming language
- Go experience is a plus but not required; Java, Kotlin or Python backgrounds translate well
- 3+ years of experience with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform
- Understanding of database internals and reliability, especially MySQL
- 8+ years of software development experience building highly scalable, highly available applications
- Experience developing, documenting, and supporting REST APIs
- Comfortable or willing to become comfortable working in a mob programming environment

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building scalable backend services and reliable core infrastructure for Smartsheet’s work-management platform. Tackling distributed systems, databases, automation, and AI-enabled engineering.
Senior Software Engineer building Smartsheet’s scalable backend and core infrastructure platform
Role description:
• Design and build scalable back-end services for Smartsheet's next-generation applications
• Solve complex distributed systems challenges with product management and key stakeholders
• Build, maintain, and scale Smartsheet's core infrastructure for reliability, stability, and performance
• Manage and upgrade large-scale database infrastructure and complex replication topologies
• Automate core operations using AWS, Golang, MySQL, Terraform, Temporal, and GitLab-CI
• Collaborate through mob programming, collective code ownership, code reviews, and architectural discussions
• Use Test-Driven Development to build resilient foundational systems
• Participate in team book clubs and psychologically safe retrospectives
• Use AI tools across coding, testing, design, and troubleshooting; explore integrations and coach others
• Participate in a gradually ramped operational on-call rotation
Role requirements:
• 8+ years of experience and proficiency in at least one modern programming language
• Go experience is a plus but not required; Java, Kotlin or Python backgrounds translate well
• 3+ years of experience with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform
• Understanding of database internals and reliability, especially MySQL
• 8+ years of software development experience building highly scalable, highly available applications
• Experience developing, documenting, and supporting REST APIs
• Comfortable or willing to become comfortable working in a mob programming environment
• Experience writing test-driven code and sharing system ownership
• Critical thinking and troubleshooting of complex technical problems
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• 1+ year of professional experience leveraging AI to improve personal productivity in building complex SaaS feature sets
• BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience
• Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis
Benefits:
• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)
• Market competitive incentive opportunity
Tech stack:
AWS, Azure, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, Kotlin, MySQL, Python, Terraform, Go
